blocks.text: ● An {o|ALL Attack} uses an ALL Attack Weapon {i:all}. When a Twin Unit makes an ALL Attack and the sub machine can also use an ALL Attack Weapon, both machines attack with them.
● ALL Attacks can't be met with a Support Attack (Attack Again) or Support Defense.
ALL Attack Weapons whose class shows {i:w} can also hit a unit adjacent to the target at the same time: a {o|Double Attack}.
